test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘CAPON’ is written as ‘EYRMP’ and ‘DECOY’ is written as ‘FCEMA’. How will ‘POWER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84fd5658d9723b0f7ffadc39b98388d29d619812e545a7e3bf12f64f1c487bfe.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84079ed4cb502eecbe1457609257b49aa769992d15f0bd41e6dcd776d36c1f5b.png] 

 AND

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97672e764fc42b772e11250632c06a3275316e9a02b84e0e0a534e6703cba309.png] 

Now the given word can be coded as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/430085d9b6fde4b5bb71ae76bc6fab7a4c08d874900309c5fc6f2ae75584caff.png] 

Hence **the answer is RMYCT.**
